_basis: git-object bytes (LF-normalised). Token figures anywhere are labelled estimates.
_seeded_from: measured sizes on the tree that introduced this file
_note: Read by seneschal/scripts/check_context_budget.py (its docstring is the design record).
Seeded from MEASURED sizes, never aspirational ones. A budget of 'whatever feels right' is red
on the day it merges, and the first thing anyone learns is that the escape hatch works.
Tier A is always-loaded startup context; tier B is loaded on a common path (a sub-router, a
subagent, a mode body). Tier C - seneschal/references/** and seneschal/docs/** leaves - is
deliberately unbudgeted: it is where detail moves when a router is trimmed.
A raise appends to `raises[]`: {"date", "from", "to", "reason"}. `to` must equal
`from` + the headroom the checker itself computes and prints (--enforce-headroom blocks on a
new entry that does not), and the chain must stay continuous: each `from` is the previous
